files.description: Treat environment names as an external deployment API. APP_ENV must remain fail-closed and limited to preview/production. Client-context values are shipped to browsers; never place secrets there. Changes to output mode, trailing slashes, integrations, or env names require matching Docker, Caddy, Railway, and build-verifier changes.

Protect cross-page invariants: preview must stay noindex, public pages must retain canonical/OG metadata, ClientRouter navigation must not duplicate global listeners or analytics, and ordinary pages must remain Astro-only without accidental React hydration.

This is a privacy boundary. Reject changes that enable persistence, profiles, autocapture, recording, remote dependencies, arbitrary event values, query/hash capture, or analytics under GPC/DNT. ClientRouter navigation must emit exactly one sanitized pageview while global listeners initialize only once.

Executable contract for static output. Route, SEO, script-loading, environment, font, or licensing changes must update these assertions without weakening preview isolation, production indexability, or the no-unexpected-JavaScript guarantee.

Production runtime contract: serve static files with real 404 status, environment-specific crawler policy, conservative caching, compression, and security headers. APP_ENV imports must fail closed; only fingerprinted assets may be immutable.

Preserve the multi-stage trust boundary: frozen dependencies and validated static build in Node/Bun, then only Caddy plus dist in the non-root runtime. Base images stay digest-pinned. Build ARG names are Railway-facing API and renames are breaking deployment changes.
